name: Oden's two-sword style
description: Oden Nitoryu: a Wano style taught only by its heirs, or learned from a scroll; huge single cuts, and it needs Armament.

stages.name: Oden's stance
stages.description: The stance of a man who carried two swords like two arms.
stages.text: You took Oden's stance, and it fit.

stages.name: Togen Totsuka
stages.text: One cut, and the hill behind your target split.

stages.name: Falling heaven
stages.description: A cut that falls like a waterfall.
stages.text: Your cut fell on your target like a waterfall.

stages.name: Heir of Oden
stages.description: The style as its founder fought it.
stages.text: You fought the way Oden fought.
